column10: SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_commandes FROM commandes AS commandes WHERE commandes.date_commande LIKE '2026-04-%' LIMIT 200
SELECT stocks.entrepot AS entrepot, stocks.quantite AS quantite, stocks.seuil_reappro AS seuil_reappro FROM stocks AS stocks WHERE stocks.ref = 'REF-8842' LIMIT 200

SELECT commandes.id AS id, commandes.date_commande AS date_commande, commandes.montant_ht AS montant_ht FROM commandes AS commandes WHERE commandes.statut = 'livree' AND commandes.date_commande LIKE '2026-06-%' LIMIT 200

SELECT p.ref AS ref, p.nom AS nom, SUM(v.quantite) AS quantite_vendue FROM ventes AS v JOIN commandes AS c ON c.id = v.commande_id JOIN produits AS p ON p.ref = v.ref WHERE c.statut <> 'annulee' GROUP BY p.ref, p.nom ORDER BY quantite_vendue DESC, ref ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_clients FROM clients AS clients WHERE clients.ville = 'Lille' LIMIT 200
SELECT SUM(commandes.montant_ht) AS montant_total_commandes_ht FROM commandes AS commandes WHERE commandes.date_commande LIKE '2026-03-%' LIMIT 200

SELECT s.ref AS ref, p.nom AS nom, s.entrepot AS entrepot, s.quantite AS quantite, s.seuil_reappro AS seuil_reappro FROM stocks AS s JOIN produits AS p ON p.ref = s.ref WHERE s.entrepot = 'LYON' AND s.quantite < s.seuil_reappro ORDER BY s.ref LIMIT 200
SELECT commandes.statut AS statut FROM commandes AS commandes WHERE commandes.id = 'CMD-2026-0042' LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) AS nombre_commandes_annulees FROM commandes AS commandes WHERE commandes.statut = 'annulee' AND commandes.date_commande >= '2026-01-01' LIMIT 200
SELECT produits.ref AS ref, produits.nom AS nom, produits.prix_vente_ht AS prix_vente_ht FROM produits AS produits WHERE produits.nom LIKE '%tétrapolaire%40 A%' LIMIT 200
SELECT SUM(v.marge_ht) AS _col_0 FROM ventes AS v JOIN commandes AS c ON c.id = v.commande_id WHERE c.date_commande LIKE '2026-05-%' AND c.statut <> 'annulee' LIMIT 200

SELECT cl.id AS client_id, cl.raison_sociale AS raison_sociale, SUM(c.montant_ht) AS montant_commande_ht FROM commandes AS c JOIN clients AS cl ON cl.id = c.client_id GROUP BY cl.id, cl.raison_sociale ORDER BY montant_commande_ht DESC, client_id ASC LIMIT 3
